attributes.description: Monitor privileged and potentially sensitive access to Druva-protected data. Investigate administrator and user activity, downloads, restores, source IPs, affected resources, data movement, and other access patterns that may indicate misuse, excessive privilege, or insider risk.

| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND (
        event.action == "Administrator Created"
        OR event.action == "Administrator Deleted"
    )
| EVAL action = CASE(
    event.action == "Administrator Created", "created",
    "deleted"
  )
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, user.name, user.id, "Unknown")
| EVAL target_admin = COALESCE(
    user.target.email,
    user.target.name,
    user.target.id
  )
| EVAL source_time = @timestamp
| WHERE target_admin IS NOT NULL
| STATS copies = COUNT(*)
  BY source_time, action, actor, target_admin
| STATS
    created_at = MIN(source_time) WHERE action == "created",
    deleted_at = MIN(source_time) WHERE action == "deleted",
    created_by = VALUES(actor) WHERE action == "created",
    deleted_by = VALUES(actor) WHERE action == "deleted",
    creation_count = COUNT(*) WHERE action == "created",
    deletion_count = COUNT(*) WHERE action == "deleted"
  BY target_admin
| WHERE creation_count > 0
    AND deletion_count > 0
    AND deleted_at >= created_at
| EVAL lifetime_minutes = DATE_DIFF("minutes", created_at, deleted_at)
| KEEP
    target_admin,
    created_by,
    deleted_by,
    created_at,
    deleted_at,
    lifetime_minutes
| SORT lifetime_minutes ASC"},"columns":[{"columnId":"target_admin","fieldName":"target_admin","label":"Administrator","customLabel":true,"meta":{"type":"string","esType":"keyword"}},{"columnId":"created_by","fieldName":"created_by","label":"Creator","customLabel":true,"meta":{"type":"string","esType":"keyword"}},{"columnId":"deleted_by","fieldName":"deleted_by","label":"Deleted By","customLabel":true,"meta":{"type":"string","esType":"keyword"}},{"columnId":"created_at","fieldName":"created_at","label":"Created At","customLabel":true,"meta":{"type":"date","esType":"date"}},{"columnId":"deleted_at","fieldName":"deleted_at","label":"Deleted At","customLabel":true,"meta":{"type":"date","esType":"date"}},{"meta":{"type":"number","esType":"long"},"columnId":"lifetime_minutes","fieldName":"lifetime_minutes"}],"timeField":"@timestamp"}},"indexPatternRefs":[{"id":"35468a9f1c574c593205cd9918a9e32d93fe4cfcfab95ce141d1a664ae63c315","title":"logs-druva.event-*","timeField":"@timestamp"}]}},"filters":[],"query":{"esql":"FROM logs-druva.event-*
